_: THE CATALOGUE — every feature, game, setting, character, sound, engine, document and artifact of the MGK-VIIIp, one row each, with a one-line pitch and a launch-run day or 'later'. The plan's week-1 deliverable (2026-09-10 reset). Pitches are HOUSE drafts for Mike's Sunday sitting of 09-20; he rules A keep / B rewrite / C cut per row on the served page. `album` names the album a row belongs to (everyman, gambler, ceo, informer) or 'machine' for shared features. `day` is the launch-run weekday (1..15) from reveal/schedule.json's order, or 'later'. `page` is where it lives on the wing: feature | album:plates | album:kit | album:papers | prologue. Sources: reveal/schedule.json (45 feature rows, 16 site rows), robots MENU_MAP v3 (28 tables, 187 rows), the unit registry, the tray photographs.

rows.name: MGK-NIAC, the twenty
rows.pitch: Twenty answers, one shake. The original engine, exactly as it left the factory.

rows.name: Starting
rows.pitch: Switch it on and watch it come up: the lamp, the glass, the test pattern, the first word.

rows.name: The monitor at rest
rows.pitch: The upper display keeps its own counsel: a diagnostic monitor that never stops reading the room.

rows.name: Probabilities
rows.pitch: A coin, a number, a card, dice, a lottery line. It does not guess; it draws.

rows.name: Messages, the inbox
rows.pitch: It receives. Voice, text and system messages arrive when they arrive, and the lamp tells you one is waiting.

rows.name: The Everyman
rows.pitch: The Everyday, boxed. The unit for the rest of us, and the first voice you will hear.

rows.name: ELIZ
rows.pitch: It listens. Tell it about your mother.

rows.name: Brain Training
rows.pitch: Five minutes a day and the machine will tell you whether it is working.

rows.name: Inkblots
rows.pitch: Ten plates. Say what you see. It writes down what that means.

rows.name: Snow Globe
rows.pitch: Shake it. That is the whole game, and it is enough.

rows.name: Tic-Tac-Toe
rows.pitch: The machine plays to a draw. It always has.

rows.name: The Gambler
rows.pitch: Comes in a case, with chips, cards and dice. Never asks what you can afford.

rows.name: The Gambler's case
rows.pitch: Leather, worn where a hand carried it. The first of the cases.

rows.name: Blackjack
rows.pitch: The house is a two-inch screen and it still wins.

rows.name: Craps
rows.pitch: Two dice, one shake, no table needed.

rows.name: Roulette
rows.pitch: A wheel in a machine that already knows where the ball stops.

rows.name: Slots
rows.pitch: Three reels behind glass. The lever is the click igniter.

rows.name: The Bullshit Detector
rows.pitch: Hold it up to the conversation. The needle does the rest.

rows.name: Detectors
rows.pitch: The microphone is real. What it hears, it reports.

rows.name: Polarity
rows.pitch: Five positions from grim to sunny. The machine's mood is a dial, and the dial is yours.

rows.name: Clarity
rows.pitch: How plainly it speaks, in registers. Turn it down and it gets interesting.

rows.name: MGK-v2.0 arrives
rows.pitch: The second engine. More answers, a new voice, and the twenty were never the limit.

rows.name: The CEO
rows.pitch: Comes in an attaché. Decides for you, then bills you for the decision.

rows.name: The Career Chooser
rows.pitch: Answer a few questions. It tells you what you should have been.

rows.name: User, your name
rows.pitch: Tell it who you are and it will use it against you, politely.

rows.name: The Informer
rows.pitch: The man on the inside. Comes with the tools, tells you nothing about where he got them.

rows.name: Radio
rows.pitch: Tune between the stations. That is where he listens.

rows.name: Phone Tap
rows.pitch: It is not admissible. It is very entertaining.

rows.name: Excuses and Lines
rows.pitch: An excuse for any occasion and a line for any room, generated, never repeated.

rows.name: Fortune
rows.pitch: A prediction with a date on it. Keep the slip.

rows.name: Maintenance
rows.pitch: Hold it still and it will tell you how it feels. Three clicks and it feels better.

rows.name: Tilt Drive
rows.pitch: Steer by tilting. The road is the upper display.

rows.name: Gobble Don't Fall
rows.pitch: Eat everything, fall off nothing. Harder than it sounds on two inches of glass.

rows.name: AvoidSteroids
rows.pitch: Rocks come at you. Revived from three hundred commented-out lines.

rows.name: Mail Run
rows.pitch: Deliver the mail. The dog is not your friend.

rows.name: Sniper
rows.pitch: Moves the target to the bullet hole.

rows.name: Stop On A Number
rows.pitch: It counts. You click. Nobody has stopped it on the number yet.

rows.name: Calculator (not installed)
rows.pitch: Listed in the menu, honestly marked. Coming, or not.

rows.name: Notepad (not installed)
rows.pitch: The same honesty, one row down.

rows.name: MGK-65 arrives
rows.pitch: The third engine, and its own voice: sixty-five answers spoken flat, the way a computer should.

rows.name: The data transfer sound
rows.pitch: You have heard it in a film. Now it means something is arriving.

rows.name: The electrical short
rows.pitch: The sound Weird.Baby makes when he appears. It came from the machine first.

rows.name: The slosh
rows.pitch: The fluid inside, moving. Mike wrote the slosh into the first firmware.

rows.name: Voices
rows.pitch: Eleven voices in the list. Each engine has its own; you can overrule it.

rows.name: The user record
rows.pitch: It keeps a record of you. You can read it. You cannot argue with it.

rows.name: The antenna selector
rows.pitch: Part of the portal, behind the prologue. Not a feature of the unit.

rows.name: Answers, the door
rows.pitch: Ask anything. Shake. The glass answers, and the answer is final until the next shake.

rows.name: Predictions
rows.pitch: Not an answer, a forecast. Filed under Answers, scheduled under the engines.

rows.name: Advice
rows.pitch: Everyday and career. The first thing the machine ever assembled from parts instead of choosing from a list.

rows.name: Codes
rows.pitch: Some rows open with a number. The manual prints the ones it prints.

rows.name: The operator's manual
rows.pitch: Sixty-three pages, typed, with the corrections left in. The device explained by the people who built it.

rows.name: The Everyday's box copy
rows.pitch: Designed with Space Age Technology. Outperforms other methods by up to 100%, and more.

rows.name: The magazine advertisements
rows.pitch: Two full-page ads, the man in the suit, the machine in his hand.

rows.name: The engineering notebook
rows.pitch: Spiral bound, dated, the kiosk and the coin slot sketched before either existed.

rows.name: The original manuals
rows.pitch: The paper ones. Photographed, not scanned.

rows.name: The MGK-PHVDC
rows.pitch: Super-charging the most powerful portable prediction system, ever. A bracket, a cable and a bulb.

rows.name: The Gambler's table
rows.pitch: Chips from four casinos, two decks, dice, and the Blue Book of marked cards. Half dollars to come.

rows.name: The CEO's desk
rows.pitch: To be photographed. The attaché and what a man like that keeps in one.

rows.name: The Informer's tools
rows.pitch: To be photographed. Lock picks first.

rows.name: The Everyday, the unit
rows.pitch: Serial 01. Bakelite black, a silver plate, two lenses that are not lenses.

rows.name: The Everyday's case and cable
rows.pitch: Oxblood leather, a strap, and the cable that made it portable.
